hook_line: ALBERTA INVITES 425 WORKERS IN FIVE DRAWS

hook_stat.sub: Invitations across five Alberta Advantage Immigration Program draws between October 23 and November 2

stats.label: Invitations via the Rural Renewal Stream
Invitations via the Alberta Opportunity Stream

diaspora_bullets: Express Entry nominees receive 600 additional CRS points
Indian professionals already working in Alberta are a large share of the Opportunity Stream pool
news_summary: Alberta issued 425 invitations to apply for provincial nomination across five Alberta Advantage Immigration Program draws between October 23 and November 2, led by the Rural Renewal Stream with 210 invitations.
payoff: Only 495 of Alberta's 6,603 nomination spaces for 2026 remain, with 32,211 candidates still active in the pool.
